subject: Request: executive waiver for 28% Hosted API rate — HealthCore commitment
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: executive waiver for 28% Hosted API rate — HealthCore commitment

Hi Ben / Mina,

Quick ask — HealthCore (Anna Liu / Ravi Patel) is asking for a 28% off list rate on Hosted API usage for a 12‑month committed agreement. Background: they are converting a successful pilot into a production rollout across three clinical regions with an aggressive volume ramp (expected token run-rate ~1.2B tokens/month by month 3). They will sign a 12‑month MRC plus a 3‑month ramp clause; they also want a public reference and a co-marketing webinar in Q4.

Why this needs exec waiver: our standard playbook tops out at 20% for hosted usage on a 12-month commit. Legal has a few nonstandard terms in SOW (data retention clarifications) and CS wants SLA visibility for multi-region failover. Sales asked me to escalate because the economics look attractive long-term (high volume, reference, marketplace listing).

Requested approval: one-time executive waiver to grant 28% off our hosted per-token usage for the committed months (with a clause to revert to standard pricing if they drop below commit). Deal id DC-2026-1147 attached.

Attachments: HealthCore_Month1_usage_estimate.xlsx (forecast + payer mix), SOW_HealthCore_v2.pdf (redlines highlighted).

If this is workable from finance/ops, we should be able to get signature this week. Can you advise yes/no and any conditions?

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

--
Note: link to HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/DC-2026-1147
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: executive waiver for 28% Hosted API rate — HealthCore commitment

Mateo — thanks for the quick summary and the attachments, I reviewed the forecast. High-level thoughts: the volume profile supports a deeper discount if commitments are enforced and we get the reference + marketplace listing. Two operational asks before I can greenlight:

1) Finance needs a break-even / 12‑month cashflow table showing net margin at 28% (can your AE ops run that or should I ask RevOps?).
2) Legal/CS must sign off on the SOW redlines — especially the data-retention language and the SLA clause for multi-region failover.

If we can get both items done, I’m comfortable recommending exec sign-off. Also propose we structure approval as: up to 28% for months 1–12 on committed usage, with a clawback if they under-deliver more than 30% vs commit in any rolling quarter.

I’ll ping Mina for quick financial clearance.

—Ben
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Ben / Mateo — reviewed the numbers and spoke with RevOps. We can provisionally approve a 28% executive waiver under strict conditions:

- Condition A: Signed 12-month commitment with a minimum monthly committed usage floor (explicit token count) and prepay of first two months;
- Condition B: Clawback clause if realized monthly usage falls below 70% of committed tokens for two consecutive months (prorated repayment or credit reversal);
- Condition C: Legal to accept SOW redline A2 (data retention) and CS signs off on the SLA addendum (I need written confirmation that cross-region failover is documented);
- Condition D: Discount applies only to Hosted API usage buckets in the SOW (no additional discounts on platform engineering services or integration work).

If Legal and CS confirm by end of day tomorrow, I give authority to proceed with the 28% concession. Please ensure commercial terms and the clawback are reflected in the DocuSign packet.

Mina Haddad
VP, Revenue Operations & Finance, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Hi Mateo / Ben / Mina,

Appreciate the rapid coordination. HealthCore is willing to accept the conditions you listed: we will sign a 12-month commitment, prepay the first two months, and agree to a minimum committed token floor (Ravi will follow up with exact numbers this afternoon). We also agree to the reference and co-marketing asks.

Two quick clarifications:
1) On the clawback: can you provide the exact repayment calculation for the prorated reversal so our finance team can review?
2) On SLA: we need an explicit RTO/RPO for region failover — can CS provide a short doc we can approve alongside the SOW?

Once Mina confirms Legal/CS sign-off and we have the DocuSign packet, HealthCore is prepared to route this for signature.
